selected_evidence.requirement: node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing normally after mirroring is configured
selected_evidence.summary: Repeated pings from node1 eth1 to node2 (192.168.50.2) show 0% packet loss both before and after mirroring was applied (an earlier interim run showed spurious loss caused by node3's firewall rejecting GRE, resolved before this final set).

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 receives a copy of node1<->node2 traffic despite being addressed elsewhere, and did NOT before mirroring was configured
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline tcpdump on node3's enp8s0 captured 0 packets during a node1<->node2 ping (segment is switch-like/isolated). After configuring gretap1 + tc mirred mirroring on node1's eth1, tcpdump on node3's gretap1 captured all ICMP echo request/reply pairs addressed to 192.168.50.1/192.168.50.2 in both directions.

selected_evidence.requirement: tc mirror filters are actively matching and mirroring traffic (not just configured)
selected_evidence.summary: tc -s filter show on node1's eth1 ingress/egress clsact filters shows non-zero matched packet/byte counters for the mirred egress-mirror action, both before and after the node1 restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Root-cause and fix of NetworkManager silently dropping manual IP config on node2/node3
selected_evidence.summary: Diagnosed enp8s0 IP disappearing due to NetworkManager marking it disconnected/unmanaged, then fixed by creating persistent nmcli 'mirror-lan' connection profiles on node2 and node3, confirmed IP restored and sticking.

selected_evidence.requirement: Root-cause and fix of node3 firewalld blocking the GRE mirror tunnel
selected_evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1's eth1 revealed node3 sending 'ICMP host unreachable - admin prohibited filter' in response to GRE mirror packets; traced to firewalld's default public zone; fixed by creating a dedicated 'mirror-segment' zone with protocol=gre allowed and binding enp8s0's NM connection to it persistently.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node1 (SONiC switch): healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 8e8823ec..., issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id c85393b1..., fixed a transient eth1 link-down state, then proved full mirroring recovery via a live ping+tcpdump mirror test and non-zero tc filter counters.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node2: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 8f258838..., issued backgrounded reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id d7d93713..., and verified enp8s0's 192.168.50.2/24 address was restored automatically via the persisted NetworkManager profile.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol - node3: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
